test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: On his daily walking route, Pritam starts walking towards the west . From a particular point, he takes a left turn and, after walking for some time, takes another left turn. He walks up to a particular point and then, takes another left turn and two quick right turns. In which direction is he walking now?
solution:
According to the given information:

 
• Pritam starts walking **towards** the** west.**
 
• Then he takes a** left turn**.
 
• Then he takes** another left turn.**
 
• Then he takes **another left.**</
